```
Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY>
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
User-Agent: VTClient/1.0
```

Replace `<YOUR_API_KEY>` with your own key (`adobe_key123` in your example) and parse the JSON response. If you need help constructing the HTTP request or interpreting the results, let me know!
